children: Boundless Bio entered into Amendment No. 1 to its merger agreement with Serapha to refine key terms ahead of closing. The amendment clarifies definitions, including items related to the company's pre-closing financing, converts all Serapha RSUs into Boundless Bio RSUs based on the exchange ratio, and introduces pre-funded warrants with a $0.00001 exercise price to manage beneficial ownership limits. It also changes the voting standard for increasing authorized common shares to a majority of votes cast. The core merger terms otherwise remain unchanged.
: Amendment No. 1 to Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization
: Refine merger mechanics and shareholder approvals
